meta.title: 衣服好坏分辨真的要细心！
meta.title_en: Judging Clothing Quality Takes a Keen Eye

scenes.context: 差的好的对比，插肩袖一看版型就有问题，因为正常的肩和手臂是两个方向。
sentences: Set-in sleeves reveal the pattern quality.
The shoulder and arm go in different directions.
paraphrase: Set-in sleeves reveal the pattern quality.
The shoulder and arm go in different directions.
scenes.speak: Set-in sleeves reveal the pattern quality. The shoulder and arm go in different directions.

scenes.context: 这种只有斜向一个方向，但手臂多数情况是放下来的，肩部就亮（松弛）太多了，又丑又不舒服。
sentences: It only supports one diagonal direction.
肩部松垮又丑又不舒服。
paraphrase: It only supports one diagonal direction.
scenes.speak: It only supports one diagonal direction. The shoulder gapes—ugly and uncomfortable.

scenes.context: 同样是插肩袖，好版型只在肩的位置捏了个省，上身以后省位正好在肩和手臂的转折点上。
sentences: Good patterns dart at the shoulder.
The dart sits right at the shoulder pivot.
paraphrase: Good patterns dart at the shoulder.
The dart sits right at the shoulder pivot.
scenes.speak: Good patterns dart at the shoulder. The dart sits right at the shoulder pivot.

scenes.context: 关键是腋下没有太多的量，整体更贴合肩部和手臂，更舒适美观。
sentences: No excess fabric under the arm.
It hugs the shoulder and arm nicely.
paraphrase: No excess fabric under the arm.
It hugs the shoulder and arm nicely.
scenes.speak: No excess fabric under the arm. It hugs the shoulder and arm nicely.

scenes.context: 无袖T恤认准这种内里有贴衬的，洗衣机里随便洗，穿到破洞都不会变形。
sentences: Look for a lined inner finish.
It won't lose shape even after heavy washing.
paraphrase: Look for a lined inner finish.
It won't lose shape even after heavy washing.
scenes.speak: Look for a lined inner finish. It won't lose shape even after heavy washing.

scenes.context: 如果看到面料折回锁边压线的直接屏蔽，这种工艺洗几次就容易出问题。
sentences: 看到折回锁边直接避开。
Skip anything with a folded, lockstitched hem.
That finish won't survive much wear.
paraphrase: Skip anything with a folded, lockstitched hem.
That finish won't survive much wear.
scenes.speak: Skip anything with a folded, lockstitched hem. That finish won't survive much wear.

scenes.context: 这种衣服你用手撑几下可能就变形没法看了，赶紧走，小心被碰瓷。
sentences: A couple of tugs and it's ruined.
Walk away before you get burned.
paraphrase: A couple of tugs and it's ruined.
Walk away before you get burned.
scenes.speak: A couple of tugs and it's ruined. Walk away before you get burned.

scenes.context: 衣服好坏分辨真的要细心：看版型、看内衬、看锁边，一眼就能避开雷区。
sentences: Judging quality takes a keen eye.
Check the cut, the lining, and the hem.
paraphrase: Judging quality takes a keen eye.
Check the cut, the lining, and the hem.
scenes.speak: Judging quality takes a keen eye. Check the cut, the lining, and the hem.

practice: 插肩袖最能看出版型好坏。
Set-in sleeves reveal the pattern quality.
Good patterns dart at the shoulder.
无袖T恤认准内里有贴衬的。
Look for a lined inner finish on sleeveless tees.
Judging quality takes a keen eye.
pitfalls: 看省位是否在肩臂转折点
认内里有贴衬的无袖T恤
